### Dark Moon — G4 unicorn stallion

Dark Moon is the quiet, recurring charcoal-gray unicorn stallion with a pale-gray mane and tail, blue eyes, and a **single white crescent-moon cutie mark**. He is a *Friendship Is Magic* background character, recognizable among the guests at **A Canterlot Wedding – Part 2** and in Ponyville's winter preparations in **Tanks for the Memories**; he also appears in crowds at the Grand Galloping Gala and many later events.

**Name and continuity:** He is **unnamed in the TV episodes**. The licensed Enterplay *Canterlot Nights* collectible-card set names him **“Dark Moon, Moonlit Colt”** (common card #11); its humorous flavor describes a wedding-crasher who loves wearing a tuxedo. This is **merchandise characterization**, not an established television storyline. Gameloft's mobile game instead calls him **“Wedding Guest Pony”**. He is not an alternate identity of Luna or Nightmare Moon.

**Speaking:** No individually credited spoken dialogue or voice actor is established. He appears among group singers, but that does not establish a solo voice credit.

**Sources:** [Character guide](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Dark_Moon) · [Canterlot Nights card list](https://mlpccg.fandom.com/wiki/Canterlot_Nights).
